seo.title: Tour Training & Familiarisation | Endemic Birds Tanzania
seo.description: Enquiry-led birding familiarisation for aspiring guides and tour operators – Southern Tanzania and Eastern Arc routes. No fixed public syllabus until confirmed with the owner.

page.title: Familiarisation for guides and operators
page.lead: Endemic Birds can host tailored familiarisation for people who will lead birding in Tanzania – especially Southern circuits and Eastern Arc forests. Programmes are agreed by enquiry; we do not list fixed course dates or accredited certificates on this site until they are confirmed.
page.enquiryNote: Everything below describes topics we can shape together – not a standing advertised curriculum.

audiences.title: Aspiring specialist guides
audiences.body: Field guides moving into endemic-focused birding who want route-specific habitat reading, pacing and guest management on forest days.

audiences.title: Tour operators and leaders
audiences.body: International companies sending a leader on a Tanzanian module who need local ground knowledge, realistic drive matrices and park–forest logistics before clients arrive.

audiences.title: In-country driver-guides
audiences.body: Experienced safari drivers who will support a senior birder on multi-day southern or arc routes.

topicAreas.title: Habitat and altitude
topicAreas.body: Miombo, floodplain, escarpment and montane forest – what to expect each day and how weather shifts the plan.

topicAreas.title: Target planning
topicAreas.body: Building a realistic species list by month without over-promising; playback, stake-outs and ethical field practice.

topicAreas.title: Logistics on our circuits
topicAreas.body: Gates, permits, lodge pacing, fuel, 4×4 legs and backup when trails are muddy or roads are slow.

topicAreas.title: Guest pacing
topicAreas.body: Listers vs photographers vs mixed groups – shared vehicle, different expectations.

deliveryOptions.title: Pre-departure briefing
deliveryOptions.body: Video or document orientation for an operator’s leader before clients fly – scope agreed in writing.

deliveryOptions.title: Field familiarisation days
deliveryOptions.body: Time on southern or arc routes with Leons or assigned leadership – duration and sites confirmed per enquiry.

deliveryOptions.title: Embedded on a private departure
deliveryOptions.body: Observe or co-lead on a paying itinerary when dates and client consent allow – not a free ride-along guarantee.

notPublishedUntilConfirmed: Fixed calendar dates and group intakes
